brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.evidence: 4 bases on one level (3 full + 1 north half), about 12 parts in all. Two joint bolts lock the full bases together. check_build reports no rule errors and meshClash clear.
drawer:0#-1,0#cut, a south-half drawer on the cut face of the half base piece:-1,0,0;half-n.

requirements.requirement: A spike at a corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: Mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at the corner where bases (0,0), (0,1) and (1,0) meet.

requirements.requirement: The spike holds a small platform
requirements.evidence: The spike carries platform-sm. The parts list has a 'Platform, small' line.

finish.summary: Compact one-level desk unit: three full bases in a triangle, plus a north half base that holds a south-half drawer. A mount spike stands where the three full bases meet and carries a small platform. Two joint bolts lock the bases together. check_build shows no rule errors and meshClash clear. Its only note is that some open faces could take caps.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
